name: Low Wideback
description: Seat the hilt deep in the palm and draw the blade up from the hip in one cut.

name: Square Bluntspine
description: Lift the blade over the shoulder and let its weight fall straight onto the target's upper arm.

name: Bushlid
description: Rap the blunt spine across the opponent's forearm to numb the grip without cutting.

name: Weedstay
description: Tuck the elbow in and hold the flat of the blade before the chest to stop a thrust.

name: Sideways Machhilt
description: Slip one short pace off the line of attack while the blade stays level at the hip.

name: Sharp Brushcut
description: Skim the edge low along the shin line as the opponent steps in.

name: Towing Cutback
description: Press the flat of the blade against the opponent's chest and shove them back one step.

name: Low Chopedge
description: Cut level through a row of upright stalks and keep the wrist straight so the same cut serves on a foe.

name: Mow Dash
description: Snap the wrist to bring the blade back along its own line and cut again on the return.

name: Scrubdrop
description: Bend at the knees and cut low across the ankles of an advancing foe.

name: Solid Widetip
description: Roll the edge off an incoming blow so the hand behind it stays covered.

name: Clearcut Skitter
description: Slide along a narrow row with feet low and wide so the cutting arm stays free.

name: Heavytang Husk
description: Hold the crossed blades together under steady downward pressure until the opponent's arm tires.

name: Weedbump
description: Swing from the shoulder in a wide arc and let the heavy blade finish the cut by its own weight.

name: Short Thickbelly
description: Drop the forward belly of the blade onto the target and let the weight carry through.

name: Quick Brushedge
description: Recover from a downswing with a diagonal rise that cuts upward on the way back.

name: Level Rivetgrip
description: Jab the clipped point forward into the gap between the opponent's arm and ribs.

name: Resting Heavytang
description: Raise the blade across the brow and take a downward blow on the thick spine.

name: Scrubstay
description: Turn the hips and let the flat of the blade slide a thrust past the ribs.

name: Quiet Lashdown
description: Shift the weight to the rear foot and step back out of reach of a long cut.

name: Mowhusk
description: Brace the free hand on the spine and press the blade down onto the opponent's guard.

name: Vinestrike
description: Sweep the blade low to high across the front and drive back anything within its arc.

name: Firm Brushcut
description: Return the sweep with a backhand pass that cuts the same arc in reverse.

name: Kept Widetip
description: Part incoming strikes aside with short outward flicks of the blade as one parts hanging brush.

name: Swaying Weightedge
description: Step forward onto the ground the sweep just cleared with the tip kept low and ready.

name: Hitching Hacksweep
description: Spread the arms and press the flat across the opponent's lead arm to hold it down.

name: Square Wideback
description: Root the rear foot and cut from the hip so the whole body's weight follows the blade.

name: Weeddrop
description: Pivot on the lead heel and slash across as the hips come around behind the edge.

name: Scrublid
description: Widen the base and hold the blade low across the thigh to turn a cut aside.

name: Mowtrot
description: Stagger the feet in a short off-beat slip that carries the body clear of a swing.

name: Square Hacksweep
description: Lunge one pace and drop the cut onto the opponent's reaching hand.

name: Holding Rivetgrip
description: Bend the knee and drop the shoulder under a swung blow so the spine takes it.

name: Catching Clearcut
description: Hook the opponent's heel with a foot while the blade checks the upper body and spills their balance.

name: Vineblow
description: Cut across a trail's width with a breath of qi in the forearm so the stroke stays flat and fast.

name: Flat Mow
description: Duck beneath an overhead blow and cut up through the opponent's wrist.

name: Angled Thickbelly
description: Hold the blade upright in a tight place and let a qi-set wrist keep the guard from sagging.

name: Easing Brushedge
description: Step sideways into the cover beside the path and cut the line the opponent must follow.

name: Scrubblow
description: Poke the point down the trail at the opponent's chest to halt a rushing step.

name: Catching Lashdown
description: Let the blade hang from a loose wrist and flick it into the opponent's reaching hand.

name: Stout Machhilt
description: Draw from the left hip across to the right shoulder with a thread of qi along the edge.

name: Blunt Cutback
description: Cut upward from beside the knee and carry the edge through the opponent's lowered guard.

name: Sudden Weightedge
description: Bring the blade overhead and drop it in a plain line with qi pooled at the wrist.

name: Solid Bluntspine
description: Cross the blade over the forearm and knock a cut aside with a short qi-backed shove.

name: Shifting Chopedge
description: Retreat two paces with the blade held level so the guard never opens.

name: Scrubstrike
description: Draw the blade back past the ear then lop forward through the target in one flowing line.

name: Rivetgrip Drop
description: Let the follow-through of the first lop carry the blade into a second cut on the way back.

name: Vinebump
description: Shorten the arc and lop low at the calf before the opponent can plant the foot.

name: Pulling Chopedge
description: Nip the edge at the elbow joint with a short lop that cramps the opponent's reach.

name: Shifting Widetip
description: Time one footfall between two lops so the body never stops flowing forward.

name: Scrubcowl
description: Stop a cut on the thick spine with the free hand braced behind it.

name: Kept Wideback
description: Slip a pace aside and brush the oncoming blade away with the flat.

name: Even Machhilt
description: Steady a breath of qi in the forearm so the next lop lands with a firmer wrist and truer line.

name: Sharp Heavytang
description: Let qi settle into the heavy belly of the blade and cut with its added bite.

name: Hitching Mow
description: Slam the weighted belly against a raised guard to jar the arm behind it.

name: Bushpause
description: Turn the front-heavy blade back across the body in one arc that sweeps a cut away.

name: Snug Bluntspine
description: Hold the dense blade steady in front with qi braced into the shoulder against a heavy blow.

name: Brushcut Amble
description: Plant the heel firmly then step off it so the blade's weight never drags the stance.

name: Bushgauge
description: Find the point where the blade balances in the hand and shift the grip until strokes fall true.

name: Short Cutback
description: Cut level at the opponent's waist with a breath of qi steadying the arm.

name: Vinehit
description: Whip the blade back along the waist line and cut again before the opponent recovers.

name: Leaden Clearcut
description: Thrust the clipped point along the belt line to stop a step.

name: Vinehusk
description: Lower the blade in front of the hips to cover the body from belt to knee.

name: Nimble Lashdown
description: Slide the hips off line with a low gliding step that keeps the blade at the waist.

name: Weedcowl
description: Press the blade flat against the opponent's belt and hold the hips from turning.

name: Gentle Thickbelly
description: Hold a level gaze at the opponent's belt and read the shift of weight before a stroke begins.
